name: Explore premium portfolio and CV action
description: Verifies the recruiter-facing portfolio remains navigable and exposes the CV action.
steps: Use navigation to open Projects and Contact
expected: The premium portfolio sections are reachable and the Download CV action opens the browser print dialog for saving the CV as PDF.

name: Open project and profile links
description: Verifies selected work and professional profile links are available.
expected: Project and professional links are visible and point to their configured destinations.

name: Use responsive mobile navigation and CV action
description: Verifies the premium portfolio remains usable at a phone-sized viewport.
steps: Navigate to Contact and select Download CV
expected: The mobile menu works, content fits without horizontal overflow, and the CV action is available.

name: Use contact action
description: Verifies visitors have a clear direct contact path.
expected: The configured email action and professional profile links are visible and usable.
